text:
sam: Starting rollout for feature flag 'new-routing-v2' in /prod at 22:00 PT. plan: 0% -> 25% (15m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (15m). Pinning model-version=2026-03-14a during canary. @deploy-bot start-window 22:00-22:45 :rocket:
deploy-bot: Release window scheduled by @sam. ID: RB-7712. Auto-rollback if error rate > 1.5% for 5m. Will post health checks every 5m.
alex: added to watchers. I'll monitor latency dashboards and rollback hook.
priya: can we hold at 25% for an extra 10m if we see slight perf degradation? prefer to validate end-to-end traces before advancing.
sam: yes, add holdpoint after 25% for 10m. if traces ok, continue. otherwise rollback to 0%.
alex: quick command to check flag state:
```
ffctl status new-routing-v2 --env prod
```
priya: also pin traffic to model-variant b-quant for 25% cohort: config snippet:
```
feature_flag: new-routing-v2
cohorts:
 - name: cohort-a
   percent: 25
   model_variant: b-quant
```
deploy-bot: Canary started. Cohort-a=25% applied. Health: ok. error_rate=0.2% latency_p95=312ms.
ops-oncall: FYI @ops-oncall - will be paged on >=1% error rate.
alex: saw a small uptick in p95 at 12:30 PT, but traces show KV cache misses from warm start. continuing to 50% unless it climbs.
sam: proceeding to 50% now. keep the holdpoint enabled for 50% -> 100% advance.
priya: if rollback needed, steps:
- run `deploy-bot rollback RB-7712` (graceful)
- remove cohort pin and set flag to 0%
- notify #incidents and #support
sam: agreed. add release notes line: "new-routing-v2: routing logic update, pins model 2026-03-14a for canary; see runbook RB-7712."
alex: all green at 100% after 28m. closing window. :tada:
priya: thanks all. will follow up with perf regression artifact if any.
deploy-bot: Release RB-7712 completed at 22:28 PT. Summary: rolled to 100%, no rollback triggered.
